annotatedSteps.description: Statement of Snell's law with formula
annotatedSteps.studentWork: Snell's law: for light of a given colour and a given pair of media, the ratio of the sine of the angle of incidence to the sine of the angle of refraction is constant: sin i / sin r = constant.
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Correctly stated with all conditions (given colour and pair of media) and formula.

annotatedSteps.description: Definition and mathematical expression of relative refractive index
annotatedSteps.studentWork: The refractive index of medium 2 with respect to medium 1 is the ratio of the speed of light in medium 1 to the speed of light in medium 2: n₂₁ = v₁/v₂.
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Accurate definition and correct mathematical expression.

teacherNote: Excellent response. Both Snell's law and relative refractive index are accurately defined with their correct mathematical formulations.
